description:
Update the configuration for contexts of a custom field of a [type](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/manifest-reference/modules/jira-custom-field-type/) created by a [Forge app](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg). Jira permissions are not required for the Forge app that created the custom field type.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the custom field, for example `customfield_10000`.
parameters.name: fieldIdOrKey

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user is not a Jira admin or the request is not authenticated as from the app that provided the field.

404.description: Returned if the custom field is not found.
